summary: HQ cursors 2: draw the cursor from the HQ sheet at window resolution
author: pm
body:
Load the staged sheet once; draw the current frame in screen space at the same logical size and hotspot as the original frame, sampled smoothly from the high-resolution source; observer crosshair unchanged.

**Done when:** the cursor looks sharp at 1440x1080, matches the old size and hotspot at 800x600, and clicks land where the tip points; reviewed.

Source: user request 2026-11-23, art working\sprite_work\cursors.png (1406x124 RGBA, measured).

**Verified, 2026-11-23:** review passed with fixes (fringe, tip) applied in the 4x re-stage; full Debug build 0 errors. In-game check is HH-0031.

comments.author: pm
comments.body: Cursor code is written (checkpoint afae53fb). Full build is on hold because the Phase 3 editor's edits are mid-flight in the same tree; my files compiled cleanly. It will be rebuilt together once Phase 3's first pass lands.
